items.summary: Add the Internet Computer custom-domain allowlist file to the frontend static assets so the deployed assets canister can serve OmniStream on the custom domain ommistream.net.

Update the repo-local mainnet deployment documentation to include a dedicated section for configuring OmniStream to be reachable at the custom domain ommistream.net, including the exact steps a user must perform outside the repo (DNS) and inside the repo (deploying the .well-known/ic-domains asset). Use English for all user-facing text.
Update the frontend environment configuration example to include the recommended Internet Identity derivation origin setting for the custom domain ommistream.net.

Improve the backend-unavailable error banner guidance so it mentions both the icp0.io canister URL format and the custom domain ommistream.net as valid access paths, and provides a clear English hint that a misconfigured custom domain can cause access failures.
